bedrooms.title: Bedrooms
bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms the guest asked for, as digits.

city.title: City
city.description: City the guest asked about, such as Portland, Seattle, or San Francisco.

max_rent.title: Maximum Rent
max_rent.description: Maximum monthly rent in dollars, without a currency symbol. Leave empty when the guest did not name a maximum rent.

move_in_window.title: Move-in Window
move_in_window.description: Pass this_week when the guest wants to move in this week. Otherwise leave empty.
